thread:
devon: FYI I opened a PR to add Asteria9b-q3_k to the model catalog and to clarify the 8k context guidance. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/model-catalog/pull/9901
liam: quick skim  main ask: please include a tiny bench summary and an explicit "supports streaming" flag. folks often miss streaming for quant variants.
rina: saw a couple of broken links in the draft: the embedding example links to /docs/embeddings which is a 404 after the nav restructure. change to /docs/features/embeddings.
devon: updated links and added a streaming boolean. added note: "streaming: supported (server-side chunking)"
kevin: we also need an SDK migration snippet: many teams still call client.generate(). show v3 -> v4 migration and a one-liner for curl. keep it compact.
devon: added both. Python v4 snippet:
```
from redwood import Redwood
client = Redwood(api_key="$REDWOOD_API_KEY")
out = client.text.generate(model="asteria9b-q3_k", input="Explain: ...")
print(out.output_text)
```
liam: please mark the quant variant compatibility: "not supported on smallest CPU plans, recommend minimum 1xT4 for dedicated test". Also mention it uses a custom KV-cache layout so warm starts behave differently.
devon: added compatibility section. note: "KV-cache layout differs from bf16 variants; warm-start efficiency may vary."
rina: bench numbers? perf team gave a short table but asked we only publish approximates and internal dashboard link for deep dives.
devon: pasted approximates inline: 
```
Asteria9b-q3_k (1xT4):
- 256 tokens: p50 30ms, p95 90ms
- 1024 tokens: p50 140ms, p95 320ms
- 4096 tokens: p50 600ms, p95 1200ms
(measurement: batch=1, temp=0.0, greedy; approx)
```
kevin: good. add a short note under "limits": "max_context_tokens: 8192 (best-effort beyond this)."
devon: updated limits and added a short line: "Expect throughput degradation past 4k tokens; consider prefix-cache or dedicated routing."
liam: can you include a 1-line prefix-cache example (curl) and mention the default cache TTL? our other cards mention 300s.
devon: added curl snippet and TTL note (default 300s).
rina: small editorial: replace "best-effort" with "best-effort (may fall back to chunked processing)". helps set expectations.
devon: fixed wording. also fixed the example to use consistent model tag `asteria9b-q3_k` (underscore in suffix intentionally denotes the q3 kernel family).
kevin: minor nit: use hyphen suffixs elsewhere; this one is ok but add an inline clarifier sentence: "Suffix convention: -q<quant> or -q<quant>_k for kernel-specific builds."
devon: added clarifier.
liam: last ask: remove any references to the old perf bucket path; use gs://redwood-perf/asteria9b/2026-q1 and add internal-only link to dashboard.
devon: updated links and added internal-only note. rebased and pushed.
kevin: LGTM pending docs-bot deploy.
docs-bot: Site rebuild queued: model-catalog. Estimated publish: ~8m.
sophie: I'll take a post-publish pass and cut a short changelog entry.
devon: thanks all, merging in 3 if no objections.
liam: no objections.
devon: merged and closing thread. :tada:
